title: ticket
description: The frontmatter of tickets/NN-slug.md (BRIEF 8.2, Implementation Decisions 2), plus pinned_difficulty and retry.

touches.description: the touch set: paths the ticket may write, enforced by the hook

software.description: the tools the ticket needs, by their names in tools.json (octave, r, julia, matlab, or a harness tool); it is not launchable until every one is recorded or its software decision said Go without (decision 17; ticket 82)

machine.description: Type-A gates: shell commands that must exit 0

quality.description: Type-B gates: questions the verifier answers

objectives.description: the objectives (research/objectives.json) the ticket serves, open when it was cut; empty or absent for one no objective asked for

goal.description: the objective with a measure whose metric the ticket reports; the metric and direction are read from that measure (Implementation Decision 17, replacing goal_metric)

sections.description: the sections of the paper the ticket adds to, set by its kind (code and experiment: methods; analysis: methods and results; lit: introduction; writing: what it writes); a Type-A check at acceptance sends the worker back when one got no passage, or Results no finding (decision 17; ticket 86). Sections never enter the touch set

proposed_by.description: BRIEF 8.2's five authors, plus the figure role, which opens the human-only decision tickets of a figure pick and a refusal and proposes the tickets its findings for the text earn (ticket 50); the verifier: a failing kill argument files the writing ticket that scopes the claims down (Implementation Decisions 11), and no one else wrote it; the tick, which opens the human-only decision ticket when the login nears its end (Implementation Decisions 7); and the conductor, which opens the ask of Implementation Decision 15 while Fable's weekly window is spent

pinned_difficulty.description: set by the human; escalation never changes it

retry.description: experiment tickets only: the footprint ladders of Implementation Decisions 6

items.description: an override object, or in a ticket file (scalar lists only) the same step spelled "--batch-size=16 NAME=value"
